overviewParagraph.overviewParagraph: The Golden Designs Maxxus Avignon 3-Person Corner Near Zero EMF FAR Infrared Sauna offers a luxurious and health-enhancing experience right in your home. Designed for indoor use, this spacious sauna is perfect for basements, master baths, or fitness rooms, providing a serene escape with its natural Canadian Red Cedar construction and advanced chromotherapy lighting. With 9 PureTech™ Near Zero EMF FAR Infrared Carbon heating panels, it promotes muscle relaxation, stress relief, and improved circulation, while the integrated FM radio and Bluetooth connectivity ensure a personalized, spa-like atmosphere. Easy to assemble and featuring a modern touch screen control panel, the Avignon sauna is a perfect blend of style, comfort, and wellness.
